WITH admin_dept AS (

    TRIM(UPPER(sis_admin_department_code)) AS admin_code_key,
    TRIM(UPPER(sis_admin_department_name)) AS admin_name_key,
    department_phone_area_code,
    department_phone_number
  FROM beaver."SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT"
), base AS (
  SELECT 
    d.department_code,
    d.department_name,
    d.department_full_name,
    TRIM(UPPER(d.department_code)) AS dept_code_key,
    TRIM(UPPER(d.department_name)) AS dept_name_key
  FROM beaver."SIS_DEPARTMENT" d
)

  a.department_phone_area_code,
  a.department_phone_number

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH dept_base AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(d.department_full_name, d.department_name) AS dept_name_key,
        d.department_name AS dept_short_name,
        d.department_full_name AS dept_long_name,
        d.department_phone_area_code AS area_code,
        CAST(d.department_phone_number AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number
    FROM departments d
), student_names AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.department_name AS dept_name_key,
        MAX(LENGTH(COALESCE(sd.full_name, ''))) AS max_name_length,
        COUNT(*) AS student_count
    FROM students sd
    WHERE sd.department_name IS NOT NULL AND sd.full_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sd.department_name
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(db.dept_short_name, sn.dept_name_key) AS department_name,
    db.area_code AS department_phone_area_code,
    db.phone_number AS department_phone_number,
    COALESCE(sn.student_count, 0) AS number_of_students,
    COALESCE(sn.max_name_length, 0) AS longest_full_name_length
FROM dept_base db
LEFT JOIN student_names sn
  ON sn.dept_name_key = db.dept_name_key
WHERE db.dept_short_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY department_name
LIMIT 200;
